summary: Today's pick in India is to buy Marico shares with a strict plan to sell if needed, while in America the advice is to wait for now. The analysts are debating whether big companies like Nvidia and Broadcom can grow a small investment ten times larger, noting that past drops of nearly ninety percent make this very risky. They also point out that fees and taxes on quick trades in India mean a stock must rise almost half a percent just to break even.
